subject.title: refactor: own model discovery by runtime lifecycle

question: Should OpenClaw make `getPreparedModelCatalogSnapshot` and `loadPreparedModelCatalog` permanent public Plugin SDK APIs while retaining `loadModelCatalog` as the deprecated source-compatible wrapper?
rationale: The implementation preserves existing callers, but the durable public Plugin SDK shape and the eventual removal policy cannot be inferred safely from code alone.

options.title: Approve the scoped SDK transition
options.body: Accept the two lifecycle-owned readers as the forward API and retain the legacy wrapper with its stated deprecation path.

options.title: Keep the lifecycle seam internal
options.body: Require the branch to avoid new public exports and provide a narrower internal migration path instead.

recommendation.title: Approve the scoped SDK transition
recommendation.body: Accept the two lifecycle-owned readers as the forward API and retain the legacy wrapper with its stated deprecation path.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature history and current branch show direct ownership of the lifecycle and Plugin SDK transition.
